text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I go to the shopping
district to pick
up some things and
encounter Найс Нэйчер
chatting with a
shopkeeper.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home after helping me out
with some
shopping, she talks sincerely
about how the
people in the shopping
district cheer her on and
motivate her to
keep going.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
